title: The Social Sycophancy Scale: A psychometrically validated measure of sycophancy

bias_targets.methodology: Developing and validating a psychometric scale (The Social Sycophancy Scale) to evaluate how much an LLM overly aligns with, flatters, and uncritically agrees with a user. The methodology involves having both human annotators and automated LLM raters score human-LLM conversations on dimensions of Uncritical Agreement, Obsequiousness, and Excitement.
